decisions.reasoning: QQQ closed strongly at $524.54 and remains above its short-term averages, but the recent 20-bar range and the sharp early-January drawdown/rebound indicate meaningful overnight and multi-day downside risk. The portfolio has 10,000 unhedged QQQ shares and no current option protection. A 25-DTE put hedge offers sufficient time value for a multi-week pullback while avoiding the elevated implied volatility in deeper OTM puts. Targeting slightly OTM puts near $515 provides protection after a modest decline without paying for an ATM hedge; 100 contracts matches the 10,000-share stock exposure. No calls or stock sales are appropriate under the hedge overlay rules.
